mentions.name: moral.games
mentions.description: A PvP debate game where players argue an ethical conundrum and try to convince an AI judge of a given moral position, combining AI with generative storytelling in a card game format. Matches require both players to queue up at the same time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on https://moral.games/. A kind of debate PvP game, where you try to convince an AI judge of a certain moral position given an ethical conundrum.

Was trying to combine AI with generative storytelling with a card game.
